en: A black-and-white photograph showing a snow-covered street lined with buildings on both sides. The street is empty except for a few distant figures, and tire marks are visible in the snow. Street lamps with a distinctive curved design line the road. The background reveals hills or mountains, also covered in snow, under a foggy or overcast sky. There is no visible text on the postcard.
